text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see... So this is where we "push them 
off the cliff," right?!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly! Like executing an 'overarm 
thrust down' right at the edge of the ring 
when you're cornered♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This is the sumo ring—no, the cafeteria 
kitchen. Now, as for why sumo terms are 
flying around in the kitchen...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Um, Trainer-san. Do you like cake?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I'm going to make a cake 
together with Akebono-san after this! I 
was hoping you could be our taste tester!
choice_data_list: If that's the case, leave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Thank you very much! Well then, shall 
we get going?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yes, this is supposed to be cake-making. 
And yet...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ah, mix the whipped cream more slowly! 
With about as much force as a "kotehineri" 
armlock throw!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Just a little "twist of the wrist"... Ah! 
It's true, stiff peaks really formed!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... When frosting the sides, is just 
gently smoothing it on enough pressure?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
No, let's go even bolder! Maybe something 
like an "inside leg trip"~♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Um, for the inside leg trip... you kind of 
go BAM like this ...Huh? Or was it more of 
a SWISH?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Hrmmm, for this, it might be best to check 
the flavor balance in person. Akebono-san, 
would you mind doing the honors?
choice_data_list:
Wait, are you two going to spar with your 
wrestling moves right here!?

Wait, are you two going to spar with your 
wrestling moves right here!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, no way~! Doing that in the kitchen 
would cause a total disaster~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's move to the gymnasium!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
First, an inner leg hook! Pretend I'm 
cream, and bring it on!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! So you don't get hurt, I'll stop 
just before the limit~♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Dosukoi!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! So it was a "hyoi"! Then next, show 
me how much to apply the chocolate with a 
"sotokomata"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, their peculiar exchange continued 
in that manner—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Haa... haa... I-I managed to do it! I even 
worked up a nice sweat.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Would you mind giving it a quick 
taste test?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Will it really turn out delicious with 
those instructions...? It looks good, but 
the taste...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Chomp...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The exquisite, silky texture of this 
cream! And the sponge cake... so fluffy, 
yet with a distinct, satisfying 
springiness!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To think such a delicate cake could be 
made!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Today's "Winning Move Cooking" was a 
huge success too, Akebono-san!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Winning moves really are amazing, 
huh~!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
You quickly figure out the right amount of 
force to use, even if you're not used to 
making wagashi, right?! I feel like this 
could be useful for other things too—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's right, training!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
If I learn training by winning techniques 
too, maybe I'll improve even faster!? 
...Trainer!
choice_data_list:
I'll memorize it with sheer guts right 
away!
Are there any tricks to memorizing it...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
In that case, if I may be so bold... as 
your predecessor, I shall become your 
master, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
When it comes to gutsy sumo, I was taught 
by my dad himself! First, to start from 
the bottom...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: Let's start by making chanko nabe!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Let's chanko~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, she learned sumo through sheer 
willpower, dreaming of the day she could 
apply it to her training...!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A trick... then it's gotta be collision 
training! When you take a move for real, 
it sticks with you differently!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head back to the gym one 
more time! First, we'll start with the 
"thrust-out" sumo move~.
choice_data_list: H-How about watching some race footage?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Build up your knowledge first, then 
put it into practice... is that it? In 
that case, leave the commentary to me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I resolved to take it slow and steady, 
diligently learning through desk study.
